title: AI Industry Shifts: Model Price Wars, UN Debates, and New Coalitions
body_md:
**TL;DR**

- Bill Gates and enterprise workflow integration emerge as rising focus areas.
- OpenAI and Anthropic engage in a new price war with updated model releases.
- UN Security Council convenes to discuss AI risks and international security.
- President Trump rejects global AI regulation, proposing an AI 'Czar' and force.

The AI landscape is seeing increased attention on Bill Gates, who is promoting a new coalition to improve global inclusivity, alongside a growing focus on integrating AI agents into business workflows. These rising topics complement a busy period of industry activity, marked by a fresh price war between OpenAI and Anthropic as both companies release more affordable, high-performance models like Claude Opus 5.5 and new GPT-6 variants.

Regulatory and safety discussions remain prominent, with the UN Security Council holding meetings on artificial intelligence and international security featuring industry leaders. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump has taken a firm stance against global AI regulation, labeling such efforts a "hoax" and announcing plans for a domestic AI "Czar" and dedicated AI force. Amid these developments, OpenAI is seeking to restore its reputation by consulting with elite mathematicians to guide its future research efforts.
